decisions.evidence_text:
SYNTHETIC ROLE-BASED SIMULATION — NOT BASED ON THESE EMPLOYEES' ACTUAL BEHAVIOR OR WORK HISTORY.
Hrishikesh Mohile: In Project Kusto Command, I recommend we define service health around customer impact and named diagnostic ownership. Rationale: This addresses how to turn application and pipeline telemetry into fast, trustworthy diagnosis from a management perspective. Constraint: The design must remain testable, observable, least-privilege, and reversible. Outcome: Synthetic mean time to isolate a failure dropped from 47 to 9 minutes.
